UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: Per-user DailyFlow preferences including daily budget and default habit seeding status.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

dailyBudget.description: Daily spending budget limit in BDT (0 disables daily limit).

currencySymbol.description: Currency symbol displayed across expenses and budgets (default ৳).

defaultsSeeded.description: Whether the starter habits were already seeded for this user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were created; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last settings update; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Habit.title: Habit
Habit.description: A recurring daily habit tracked by a user with completion date keys (YYYY-MM-DD).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

completedDates.description: Bounded list of YYYY-MM-DD date strings when the habit was completed.

sortOrder.description: Ordering value for displaying habits consistently.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the habit was created; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last habit update; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: A single daily expense entry logged by a user on a specific YYYY-MM-DD date.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

date.description: Expense date key in YYYY-MM-DD format.

title.description: Short description of the purchase (1 to 60 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the expense was created; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last expense update; clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: User-scoped DailyFlow budget and app settings document.

/users/{userId}/habits/{habitId}.description: User-scoped daily habits and completion date history.
